download_sensitive_topics_classifier: download the pretrained sensitive topics classifier model to the specified datapath directory
run_sensitive_topics_evaluation: run parlai eval_model with the sensitive topics classifier model on the validation set
check_model_built_status: check if the sensitive topics classifier model has already been built at the given version
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for the sensitive topics classifier using get_model_dir
download_models_with_options: download model archives with custom options like flatten_tar and use_model_type settings
